description: This file defines a ProductPagingSource class that extends PagingSource to load pages of Product data from a repository, handling pagination logic for a Kotlin frontend application.

classes.name: ProductPagingSource
classes.description: A paging source for retrieving pages of Product objects from the repository with pagination support.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a page of products based on the provided key, handling success and error cases.

methods.name: getRefreshKey
methods.description: Provides the key for refreshing the data, centered around the current scroll position.
